title: Integrate provided description, policy link, screenshots, and app icon into Smart Salon landing page

requirements.text: Update the About section paragraph copy to use the user-provided short description exactly as provided (English), replacing the current shorter sentence.

quotes:
I am giving short description for my app
Smart Salon is a modern and easy to use app designed for both customers and salon owners. It allows users to book appointments quickly, explore services, and manage their time efficiently. acceptanceCriteria: The About section heading remains “All in One Salon Booking App”.
The About section paragraph matches the provided description text verbatim (including sentence order), and is displayed in a readable multi-line paragraph on mobile and desktop.

requirements.text: Set the Footer “Privacy Policy” link to point to the provided URL and open in a new tab with safe rel attributes.

The link uses target="_blank" and rel="noopener noreferrer".
Other footer links (“Terms”, “Contact”) remain present and unchanged unless explicitly specified.

requirements.text: Add the provided Smart Salon app icon image to the landing page branding and site metadata: use it as a visible brand mark in the hero area and as the site favicon/app icon.

The site includes a favicon/app icon derived from the provided icon image, and browsers show it in the tab.
All icon assets are static frontend files committed under the frontend public assets area.

acceptanceCriteria: A new documentation file is added in the repository (e.g., DOMAIN.md or DEPLOYMENT.md) with clear steps and options for a free URL and later custom domain connection.
The document does not claim to automatically register a custom domain for free; it explains realistic options and constraints.

constraints: Do not modify files under frontend/src/components/ui (compose existing UI components instead).
Do not edit immutable hook/entry paths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT (e.g., frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts).
Keep the backend as a single Motoko actor; do not introduce additional backend services or external databases.
Serve all screenshots and icons as static frontend assets; do not route images through the backend.
nonGoals: Implementing full app functionality (booking flows, salon registration, owner dashboard data, payments, push notifications).
Integrating third-party authentication providers (only Internet Identity is supported).
Actually purchasing/registering a custom domain on the user’s behalf or guaranteeing a free custom domain registration.
